_doc: Gameplay geometry the rules read through TankGeometry (the frozen keys), in rules px (art px / 1.5). The tank's own geometry is content/tank/tanks.json tanks.landship.geometry, which TankGeometry.with_tanks lays over this file. screen: the view's ground line, hull rear and skirt gap. enemies.<sprite>: relative to that sprite's top-left facing left (toward the tank); hitbox [x, y, w, h] is the only hit area where present. boss: relative to boss_hull's top-left, facing left; bogies [x, y, w, h] rear to front are the hit boxes of parts 0..2 and turret.rect that of part 3 (TankBossState.part_id). Measured on the v2 kit's sprites: the bogies are three 110 x 122 art px boxes down to the track's ground row, turret.rect the turret block on the deck, turret.muzzle the main gun's left end. Frozen contract (contracts/README.md 'Geometry'): a re-measure may change the values, never their names or frames; rules code and tests read them through TankGeometry, never hard-coded.
